description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Cooper Kupp was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kupp was upgraded after he was limited to start the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.
items.title: Cooper Kupp (back) practices fully Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: George Holani was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Holani was upgraded after he was limited on Wednesday to begin the week. He should be good to go in his depth role on Sunday against the Commanders.
items.title: George Holani (knee) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jadarian Price was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Price has been limited in practice on back-to-back days to begin the week. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) limited in practice Thursday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Sam Darnold was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Darnold continues to trend in the right direction after he was limited to start the week on Wednesday. He is on track to return on Sunday against the Commanders.
items.title: Sam Darnold (glute) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Mims has been limited at two-straight practices to start the week, so it's unclear which way he is trending for Week 3. Whether he's playing or not, fantasy managers shouldn't expect his injury status to come with a big impact for fantasy purposes this week.
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: RJ Harvey (hamstring) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Harvey missed last week's game due to a hamstring injury that he has been dealing with, but he was able to return to a full practice on Thursday, so it seems likely that he will suit up and play in Week 3. He will likely continue to share the backfield with J.K. Dobbins (hip), though it looks like rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) will be out of his hair for at least a week.
items.title: RJ Harvey (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) did not take part in Denver's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has now missed two-straight practices to start the week, so he seems to have an uphill battle to play in Week 3. RJ Harvey (hamstring) and J.K. Dobbins (hip) are both back to practicing in full, so it looks like they will be the two guys holding things down for Denver's backfield on Sunday.
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Billy Bowman Jr. (Achilles) is active for the Falcons' Thursday night game against the Packers.
items.impact: The Falcons get their starting nickel corner back against the Packers. He will provide much-needed help to their injured secondary.
items.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (Achilles) active for Thursday Night Football

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Jack Strand (healthy scratch) is inactive for Thursday Night against the Packers.
items.impact: Strand had a chance to show his stuff in the Falcons' loss to the Panthers, and his stuff wasn't great. Don't count on him to have many more appearances this season, and if he does, Atlanta players will be nigh unstartable.
items.title: Jack Strand inactive on Thursday against Packers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins (hip) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Dobbins is expected to be good to go for Week 3 after being upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. RJ Harvey (hamstring) was also able to practice in full, but rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) was absent, so it looks like Denver's backfield is still expected to be at less than full strength in Week 3.
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) logs full practice session Thursday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Cooper Rush will be the Falcons' emergency third QB for their game against the Packers.
items.impact: Rush was awful in his chances as a starter through two weeks, so heaven forbid he see his name called up again.
items.title: Cooper Rush emergency 3rd QB for Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Vikings managed O'Neill's lingering knee issue by letting him remain limited on Wednesday, but he practiced in a full capacity on Thursday and should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers. His presence will be important for Minnesota's offense as a whole in what projects to be a favorable matchup in Week 3.
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: DeeJay Dallas (toe) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dallas was unable to practice in full on Thursday and remained limited due to his toe injury. He seems likely to play this week still, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to play more than a depth role this week with Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) trending towards playing against the Buccaneers.
items.title: DeeJay Dallas (toe) limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returned to Minnesota's practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was unable to practice due to a knee issue on Wednesday, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was able to participate in a limited fashion. He's tracking towards playing in Week 3, but we won't know his official status for Sunday's game until sometime after practice on Friday.
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Dareke Young (hamstring) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Young should be good to go this week, as he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by a hamstring injury on Wednesday. He's not expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.
items.title: Dareke Young (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowers continues to trend the right way for Week 3. He was able to participate at practice again on Thursday, although he remained limited as the team continues to take caution with his recovery. It looks like he is gearing up to play this week, and if that's the case, he will return to being a must-start fantasy option, even if he is on a slight pitch count against the Saints.
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jamel Dean (ankle) was listed as limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran cornerback returned to practice and was able to participate in a limited fashion on Thursday, which bodes well for his Week 3 availability. His presence will be very important this week in a tough matchup against Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase, and the rest of Cincinnati's stacked offense this week.
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) listed as limited participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Warren was able to take part in Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday in a limited fashion, which is a good sign that he will be available to play in Week 3. Rico Dowdle (toe) seems to be trending towards being out against the Bengals, which would leave Warren as the workhorse running back and a good fantasy option for the team this week if he's healthy.
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) officially limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young cornerback has been limited for conditioning purposes for a while now, so this designation comes as no surprise on Thursday. It remains to be seen if he will play this week or not, but Pittsburgh's secondary will see a massive upgrade if he's good to go against the Bengals.
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning) limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was again a limited participant at practice on Thursday. He missed last week's game due to a foot issue, but he seems to be recovering well and will have a chance to play this week. We should know more about his status when the team's official game statuses get released after practice on Friday.
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: David Bailey (elbow) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Bailey's status for Week 3 looks good right now, as he has been a full participant at practice all week so far. His elbow injury is not a serious issue and it seems like a near certainty that he will play through it against the Lions this week.
items.title: David Bailey (elbow) logs another full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) has been added to the injury report as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell wasn't on New York's injury report to start the week, but he has since been added due to a finger injury that prevented him from practicing in full on Thursday. This is a situation worth monitoring for fantasy managers throughout the rest of the week, as Mitchell saw 12 targets in last week's game and would vacate a lot of opportunities if inactive in Week 3.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) added to injury report Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Taylor is at risk of missing Sunday's game. He has been sidelined at both of New York's practices to start the week, and it looks like the team is taking the cautious approach with his thumb injury at this point. If he's ruled out, expect rookie Kenyon Sadiq to see more work than usual in his absence.
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) misses another practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (foot) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It remains unclear if Ossai will play this week, as he has been limited at both of the team's practices so far. New York's defense would greatly benefit from having him available to play in a tough matchup against the Lions, however.
items.title: Joseph Ossai (foot) listed as limited Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (back) was still sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Jets are likely to be without their veteran running back again in Week 3, as he was unable to take part in yet another practice on Thursday. His likely absence won't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective, however.
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) still sidelined Thursday

title: Fantasy Player News
